name: persian_king_480bc

candys.notes: pleated skirt (zigzag), hem hitched up at the sides, belted

sleeves.notes: upper sleeve + wide bag hanging from the forearm

tiara.notes: tall upright felt tiara with gold rosette band

design_source: Persepolis reliefs (Treasury audience relief, Apadana, palace door jambs); Xenophon Cyropaedia 8.3.13 (purple robe, crimson trousers, upright tiara); Xenophon Anabasis 2.5.23; Herodotus 7.61
replaces: v1: Greek chiton + himation in purple + paper-bucket crown (xerxes_test.py)
licence: our own code (Blender cloth simulation); scanned fabrics CC0 Poly Haven (rough_linen, caban, hessian_230); MakeHuman body CC0

self_rating.notes: candys works in ANY pose: wide sleeves from raised forearms (audience) or bell sleeves (arms hanging), robe passes over hanging arms, closed neckline, upright tiara with rosettes (main session's finer fluting kept). Beard style = WS1.
